save_subscription

Create or fully replace one subscription from a complete Subscription record (same shape as get_subscription.record): phases, payments with per-charge methodId / settled / kind (refund, adjust, failed) / funding (split across sources), status (active, trial, paused, cancelled, terminated), stop and end. Use it to enter a whole history at once (several phases, region or plan switches, every past charge) or to record an already-stopped subscription; for single edits prefer the narrower tools. The record is the entire new state, stored as given like the web editor’s save (keep top-level price/currency/cycle/methodId equal to the last phase): omitted fields are removed and null values are dropped; methodId absent or null means no payment method (no default is applied). cancelled / terminated without end or stop means stopped on an unknown date. Runs the same normalization and validation as saving in the web editor (renewal-rule history, clearing a member exit clears its refund, full-record and status-transition checks); referenced payment methods must exist. Without id, or with an id that does not exist, it creates a subscription; a same-name same-start duplicate then requires force=true. Preview returns changes (field-level before/after against the stored record) and computed before/after: status, next charge, last charge, total spent to date and charge count.

list.name: set_status
list.title: Update subscription status
list.description: Mark as trial (action=trial, trial_end is the first paid charge date; null clears; stopped subscriptions must resume a new phase first); pause (recoverable); cancel with immediate=false (default): do not renew after at, the last service day; cancel with immediate=true: voluntarily stop using it on at; terminate: provider disabled access on at, with optional reason. Immediate cancel and terminate compute the original paidThrough and accept an optional refund (positive amount, stored negative in the subscription currency; settled is the actual card refund). Omit refund when no refund information was supplied; never invent one. The tool derives paidThrough from the existing billing history, so the user need not confirm automatically inferred charges before you stop it. Inferred charges in a stopped gap disappear when the status and resumed phase dates change; do not delete or ask to confirm those estimates as if they were recorded payments. When the user supplies both the termination date and the later restart date/price/cycle, terminate at the supplied date, then change_plan action=resume; no optional refund clarification is required to make those known changes. Preview includes paidThrough, suggestedRefund, unusedDays, unusedValue and wastedDays. Terminated subscriptions cannot reactivate; use change_plan action=resume to resubscribe with a new phase. Reactivate clears pause, stop and end for other subscriptions. To correct an existing stop (date, non-renewal vs immediate cancel, reason, refund) pass edit=true with action=cancel|terminate; omitted fields keep the recorded values and a provider termination stays terminate. An undated stop needs its real date in at. cancel / terminate never assume today for a subscription that started or was charged before today: pass the actual date in at, or at=null when the user only knows it has stopped (stored as cancelled / terminated with no end or stop date; no refund or reason then).

subscription.description: Subscription id, or its name (fuzzy match; ambiguous names return candidates).

at.description: Non-immediate cancel: last service day. Immediate cancel / terminate: actual stop day. Required for cancel / terminate when the subscription started or has charges before today; null = stopped on an unknown date. pause / trial default to today.

edit.description: Correct an already stopped subscription with action=cancel|terminate: change the stop date (at; omitted keeps it), non-renewal vs immediate cancel, reason or refund. Provider termination cannot become cancel.

Optional currency must equal the selected phase currency for every kind (charge, refund, adjust, failed); a different card currency belongs in settled. settled = what the card was actually charged in another currency (e.g. TRY subscription billed in USD). method = payment method (id or name) used for this one charge when it differs from the phase’s method; null clears it; omitted keeps a replaced charge’s own method. funding = one order paid from several sources (amounts in the subscription currency summing to amount, e.g. 178.80 = PayPal 168.05 + Balance 10.75); wallet balances are reduced by each part. funding and method are exclusive; null clears a split; omitted keeps a replaced charge’s split. Null clears since/collect_from/owner_name so defaults can be inferred again. role none stops sharing (subscription must then be its id or exact full name). rule sets the owner plan collection rule {fee, fee_currency, bill_every}: members following the rule get the new fee from rule_from (default today) as a dated fee change, keeping receipts and earlier periods; custom-fee, exempt and departed members are untouched. The first time a rule is saved, members whose fee differs are marked custom. Returns the effective rule. Describe the returned fee, cycle, date and affected members; do not infer annual income or savings from this result.

list.name: save_share_member

list.description: Add a member to a shared plan I organize, or update one (pass member = id or name to update). fee = how much they pay each time, in fee_currency (defaults to the collection currency), every bill_every months (1 monthly, 3 quarterly, 6 half-yearly, 12 yearly). exempt = takes a seat but pays nothing. paid_until = settled before record-keeping through this date (periods starting on/before it become an opening settlement with no amount; null removes it); record real money with record_receivable. Only the joining period aligns to the shared anchor; later periods follow the member’s own billing cycle. Fee changes use fee_from (default today), preserve the old rate and receipts, and apply to whole periods starting on/after that date. A mid-period join covers joined through the aligned period end inclusive: first_period prorate (default, actual days / full period days, rounded to cents), full, or free. first_amount optionally overrides the first amount in fee_currency; free always charges zero. Later periods use the regular fee. Use save_person for name/contact changes of a linked roster person; person=null detaches the link. New members default to the plan collection rule (see get_carpool rule) when fee and bill_every are omitted. follow_rule=true makes the member follow the plan rule from fee_from (default today); follow_rule=false keeps their own fee. Changing fee, fee_currency or bill_every without follow_rule marks the member custom unless the result at fee_from equals the rule. Each call inserts/replaces one dated fee point; later fee_history points remain. For an ongoing custom rate, also replace conflicting later points with the same fee and cycle. Do not postpone fee_from to avoid them; omit it to start today. Set left to retain all join/receipt history. Optional leave_refund stores the actual positive refund, with date defaulting to left and currency to the suggested refund currency; null means no refund. left=null also clears the refund. Preview returns suggested_refund (including original-currency parts) and unused_days; never save the suggestion as an actual refund without user confirmation. list.name: record_receivable
list.title: Manage receivable records
list.description: Receivables are kept per period: each shared-plan member period (identified by its start date) and each proxy charge (identified by its charge date) is paid, waived, free, due or upcoming; periods need not be settled in order. Read periods, statuses, receipt_id and waiver_id with get_subscription. action=record (default) records money received: periods = the period keys it covers (may skip earlier unpaid ones, may be future = prepayment), or count = the N earliest unsettled periods (default 1). amount defaults to the total due of those periods (converted to currency at the receipt date); an explicit amount is the actual receipt and is split across the periods in proportion to their dues. action=waive marks periods as not owed (no money). action=update replaces receipt/waiver id with the given fields (periods/amount/currency/date/note; omitted fields keep their values). action=delete removes receipt/waiver id; its periods become unsettled again (subscription and member must be ids or exact names). action=charged (proxy only) sets the actual card charge of one charge date: charged_amount and charged_currency; null charged_amount clears the override. A period can be covered by only one record. Pass person (name or id) instead of subscription/member/kind: their only open item is picked (pass subscription when they owe on several).
